environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 native image deployed on AWS Lambda with provisioned concurrency (warm instances), connected to PostgreSQL RDS via direct VPC link. Database role 'app_service_rw' has full CRUD permissions on all tables. Lambda timeout 30s, memory 512MB. No rate limiting on API Gateway. Network latency to RDS is sub-millisecond due to same-AZ placement with enhanced networking enabled.

config.db_permissions: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on ALL TABLES
